letter.subject: Expression of interest: junior Civil Designer, Townsville
paragraphs: I'm registering my interest in a junior Civil Designer position in your Townsville team after seeing Spiire's expression of interest advert on SEEK. The ad asks to hear from civil designers at junior level as the Townsville business grows around urban development, and that is the level and the work I'm looking for.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides, lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services, and prepared cost estimates, bills of quantities, options analyses and risk registers. Before that I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019, which covered hydraulics, surveying, structural principles and construction methods.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, as field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works and, before that, project-in-charge on a community hall renovation. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them, carried out inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and kept site reports and progress records. Subdivision work from the builder's side is the closest I have come to the urban development projects your Townsville team is set up for.

I have not worked in an Australian design office yet, so my design software experience is AutoCAD and Civil 3D from the diploma, and I would be learning your design and drafting tools on the job. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Townsville.

My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Happy to talk whenever suits the Townsville team, and to hear what a junior designer's first projects would be.

checklist: Decide first whether you would move to Townsville: the letter and email say "open to discussing relocation to Townsville". If the answer is no, do not apply.
Open the Spiire job board listing https://spiire.elmotalent.com.au/careers/spiire/job/view/796 (the SEEK ad 94631744 links out to it) and press Apply.
Attach the two PDFs from this record (resume and cover letter); answer the portal questions honestly (junior level, Subclass 485 visa to December 2027, real availability).

Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "Company website". Only after that, the prepared email to spiire.careers@spiire.com.au (the careers page invites expressions of interest with a CV and motivation letter) may be sent as a follow-up.
notes: Open expression of interest for Spiire's new Townsville office (urban development focus); junior civil designers named in the ad. Spiire is on the target employer list. Townsville page names Zac Strogusz (Business Manager) and Adam Pease (Principal, Civil Engineering) without emails; the careers inbox spiire.careers@spiire.com.au is published for expressions of interest with a CV and motivation letter, so a follow-up email is prepared for after the portal submission. Interstate: Townsville relocation is Marc's call.
